label: Generate Image
description: Make an image from a prompt, or change images you give it, with the image models ElevenLabs serves (GPT Image, Gemini, Seedream). Wire one image to edit it, or several for the model to draw from, like a product photo and a face. On GPT Image models, a mask limits the edit to part of the first image. If you set something the model does not take, the call is refused before anything is charged. Needs your own ElevenLabs account on a Pro plan or above.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account: wire an ElevenLabsAccess node whose connection has "Images and video" ticked. weft's built-in connection cannot make images or videos, and each one is paid from this account's credits.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: What the image should show, or what to change in the images you give it.
inputs.placeholder: A corgi in a tiny lifeguard chair on a sunlit beach, photorealistic

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The image to edit, or several to draw from. A mask applies to the first one. Up to 5 on GPT Image 1, GPT Image 1.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash; up to 10 on GPT Image 2, GPT Image 2.5, Gemini 3 Pro and Seedream; up to 14 on both Gemini 3.1 models.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: GPT Image models only: the first image is edited where this one is fully transparent. Needs `images`.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: gemini-3.1-flash-image is Nano Banana 2: fast, and good at drawing text. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst is for detailed output and precise edits; gpt-image-2.5-flare is the faster one, for high volume. The Seedream (ByteDance) models are refused with `model_access_denied` until ElevenLabs approves your workspace; ask ElevenLabs support for access.

inputs.name: aspectRatio
inputs.label: Aspect ratio
inputs.description: Leave empty for the model's default: 1:1 on GPT Image 1 and 1.5, 16:9 on the rest. `auto` lets the model match the images you give it. GPT Image 1 and 1.5 take only 1:1, 3:2 and 2:3; Seedream takes only auto, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9 and 9:16. Only GPT Image 2 and 2.5 take 2:1, 1:2, 3:1 and 1:3, and only gemini-3.1-flash-image takes 4:1, 1:4, 8:1 and 1:8.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.description: Leave empty for the model's default: 2K on Seedream, 1K on the others that take a resolution. GPT Image 1, GPT Image 1.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash take none, and gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image takes only 1K. 4K works on GPT Image 2 and 2.5, Gemini 3 Pro and gemini-3.1-flash-image, which alone also takes 512. Seedream 5 Pro takes 1K or 2K, Seedream 5 Lite 2K or 3K.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.description: GPT Image models only. Leave empty for the model's default: high on GPT Image 2.5, medium on the others. Only GPT Image 2.5 takes xhigh and max.

inputs.name: background
inputs.label: Background
inputs.description: GPT Image 1 and 1.5 only. If you want a cut-out, pick transparent. Leave empty for auto.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Seedream models only. If you want to be able to make a similar image again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same inputs. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated image, stored with the run and deleted with it (once the run's record goes); wire it through KeepFile to keep it past that.

then.message: ElevenLabsGenerateImage '{id}' has a `mask` but no `images`: a mask marks the part of the first image that may change, so wire the image to edit into `images`.
